definitions.explanation: A painting or pictorial work executed directly on a wall, whether ancient cave art, religious imagery in temples, or modern street murals.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}の{壁画|へきが}を{見学|けんがく}した。
examples.english: I visited some ancient wall paintings.

examples.japanese: この{寺|てら}の{壁画|へきが}は{江戸時代|えどじだい}に{描|えが}かれた。
examples.english: The murals in this temple were painted in the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}アーティストが{駅前|えきまえ}のビルに{巨大|きょだい}な{壁画|へきが}を{描|か}いている。
examples.english: Young artists are painting a giant mural on the building in front of the station.

notes:
Composed of {壁|かべ} (wall) + {画|が} (picture). Covers everything from prehistoric cave paintings to modern street art.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁画|へきが}を{描|えが}く: to paint a mural
- {古代|こだい}の{壁画|へきが}: ancient wall painting
- {壁画|へきが}を{修復|しゅうふく}する: to restore a mural
- {寺|てら}の{壁画|へきが}: temple mural

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絵画|かいが}: painting — general term for paintings on any surface, especially canvas
- {天井画|てんじょうが}: ceiling painting — painting on a ceiling rather than a wall
